AUTHOR: Jenrette
TITLE: Shark detection and classification with machine learning
SPECIES: Sharks: 219 species in database, 26 genera + 47 species classifiable
DATA: sharkPulse crowd-sourced archive + Instagram images (53,345 shark, 50,260 non-shark); evaluation on 2 BRUV videos, 5 YouTube videos, Instagram hashtag datasets
D2: SI: 90% train / 10% validation; SC split not stated
D_EV: Sec. 2.2: 'We trained the model with 90% of the training set, and validated with the remaining images'; Sec. 2.4: 'We removed duplicate images by comparing their pixel content'
R_EV: Sec. 2.4: 'we post-processed two BRUV videos and 5 YouTube (YT) videos'; Sec. 3: 'Accuracy for all models across the three data-generation methods are shown in Figure 4e.'
C_EV: Sec. 3.2: 'We spent 6.2 hours manually validating all of the extracted frames'; 'The SL showed 93% specificity and a false-positive rate of 7%'
E_EV: Sec. 2.4: 'we calculated recall, precision, specificity and F1' (no ecological variable derived; occurrence records only mentioned as preliminary)
ARCH: Faster R-CNN (Shark Locator), VGG16 binary (Shark Identifier), DenseNet201 hierarchical genus/species classifiers
METR: recall, precision, specificity, F1, FPR, FNR, ROC AUC, top-1/top-3 recall
NOTE: INCL=N under P4: training/most evaluation imagery is web/social-media photos (Instagram, sharkPulse), many above water; only 2 BRUV videos are in-situ underwater footage. Verifier should confirm exclusion; all fields coded anyway. Shark Locator pre-trained on COCO, SI/SC on ImageNet. SI split 90/10 at image level ('random' not stated); duplicate removal applied to Instagram datasets -> D3=Y, D_ALL=P. R: evaluation on BRUV/YouTube videos and new Instagram sets differs from training sources; in-domain test accuracies (Table 5) and video/Instagram results (Table 2-4, Fig. 4e) reported numerically -> R3=Y (generous reading; CONF low). C5: all 8,185 extracted video frames manually validated with FP rate reported. 'other genus/other species' classes are catch-all classes, not a reject option (C4=N). Thresholds 0.9/0.99/0.5 and ROC over thresholds 5e-6-0.999 reported. Text file is the Nov 2021 author manuscript.
